title: UMNG staff strike and academic inactivity (possible continuity from September)

start_date.summary: Adiac reports strike start 1 Oct. A later ACI retrospective in unit December reports inactivity since 27 Sep (cross-unit source COB12S001).

notes: Start ownership conflicts and no public gathering is documented; treat as a collective labor action continuity lead, not a coded protest. Cross-unit source ref: congo_brazzaville_2024-12 / COB12S001.
